summary: Writes the message as a file to an S3-compatible bucket.

properties.name: BucketName
properties.description: Name of the bucket to upload files to.

properties.name: FolderName
properties.description: Folder (object key prefix) within the bucket to upload files to.

properties.name: FileName
properties.description: Name to give the uploaded object. If empty, a name is generated from the current timestamp and a GUID.

properties.name: FileExtension
properties.description: Extension appended to the generated object key (e.g. json, csv). Ignored if FileName is set.

properties.name: ContentType
properties.description: Content-Type to set on the uploaded object (e.g. text/plain, application/json).
